rows.text: calls `001B4930(rcx)`; then walks 0x20-byte entries `E` from qword `rcx+8` up to qword `rcx+0x10` (re-read after each entry; nothing when they are equal), and for each one zeroes a local 0x18-byte block `B`, calls `001EDF00` with the address of the local qword just past `B` and `E+0x18`, calls `001A4BF0(B, qword [E], qword [E+8])`, and passes `rcx` and `B` to the call at `001B5140` + 0x58

returns 0 at once when dword `rcx+0x258` is 1; otherwise loops: passes `rcx+0x4f8` to the call at `00679ED0` + 0x27, then calls `00679BF0(rcx)` only when dword `rcx+0x268` is 1 or 2 and dword `rcx+0x25c` is not 2, and repeats until dword `rcx+0x258` reads 1, then returns 0

notes: Doubts per function. 001B5140: the 0x18-byte block is zeroed by a 16-byte store at rsp+0x20 plus a qword at rsp+0x30, and 001EDF00 receives rsp+0x38 (the qword right after the block) as rcx; whether the callees treat block+0x18 as part of one larger local is not shown. The call at +0x58 targets a body in the cutscene-name-slots pack (not named here per the call-site rule); no return value is set by this body after the loop. 00679ED0: the loop has no exit other than dword +0x258 reading 1, so it relies on the call at +0x27 or 00679BF0 changing it.
